mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE paged_roots AS ( SELECT bbs_id, CASE WHEN notice_yn = 'Y' AND (notice_start_dt IS NULL OR notice_start_dt = '' OR notice_start_dt <= TO_CHAR(NOW(),'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND (notice_end_dt IS NULL OR notice_end_dt = '' OR notice_end_dt >= TO_CHAR(NOW(),'YYYY-MM-DD')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS notice_eff FROM t_bbs WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND p_bbs_id = 0 AND bbsinfo_id = #{bbsinfoId}::integer AND title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' ORDER BY notice_eff DESC, bbs_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ), thread AS ( SELECT b.bbs_id, b.p_bbs_id, 0 AS lvl, pr.notice_eff AS root_notice, b.bbs_id AS root_id, ARRAY[b.bbs_id] AS path FROM t_bbs b JOIN paged_roots pr ON pr.bbs_id = b.bbs_id UNION ALL SELECT c.bbs_id, c.p_bbs_id, t.lvl + 1, t.root_notice, t.root_id, t.path || c.bbs_id FROM t_bbs c JOIN thread t ON c.p_bbs_id = t.bbs_id WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT b.bbs_id::TEXT AS db_key, b.bbsinfo_id, b.title, b.notice_yn, b.secret_yn, b.view_cnt, b.good_cnt, b.reg_id, b.bbs_dt, t.lvl AS bbs_depth, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt, (SELECT r.file_id FROM r_file r JOIN t_file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = b.bbs_id AND r.file_loc = 'BBS_IMG' ORDER BY r.ordr LIMIT 1) AS file_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_comment cm WHERE cm.bbs_id = b.bbs_id AND cm.use_yn = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, CASE WHEN t.lvl = 0 THEN t.root_notice ELSE 'N' END AS notice_eff FROM thread t JOIN t_bbs b ON b.bbs_id = t.bbs_id ORDER BY t.root_notice DESC, t.root_id DESC, t.path

SELECT b.bbs_id::TEXT AS db_key, b.bbsinfo_id, b.title, b.view_cnt, bi.bbsinfo_nm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_comment cm WHERE cm.bbs_id = b.bbs_id AND cm.use_yn = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_bbs b LEFT JOIN t_bbsinfo bi ON bi.bbsinfo_id = b.bbsinfo_id WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_bbs_id = 0 AND b.reg_id = #{regId} ORDER BY b.bbs_id DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_bbs WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND p_bbs_id = 0 AND bbsinfo_id = #{bbsinfoId}::integer AND title LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'

SELECT bbs_id::TEXT AS db_key, bbsinfo_id, title, context, p_bbs_id, bbs_depth, bbs_ordr, secret_yn, bbs_pw, good_cnt, bad_cnt, view_cnt, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_content_like l WHERE l.target_type = 'BBS' AND l.target_id = t_bbs.bbs_id AND l.user_id = #{viewerId}) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS liked_yn, notice_yn, notice_start_dt, notice_end_dt, bbs_dt, reg_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = t_bbs.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = t_bbs.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_bbs WHERE bbs_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_bbs (bbsinfo_id, title, context, p_bbs_id, bbs_depth, bbs_ordr, secret_yn, bbs_pw, good_cnt, bad_cnt, view_cnt, notice_yn, notice_start_dt, notice_end_dt, bbs_dt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{bbsinfoId}::integer, #{title}, #{context}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pBbsId}, '')::integer, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{bbsDepth}, '')::integer, 1), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(bbs_ordr), 0) + 1 FROM t_bbs WHERE bbsinfo_id = #{bbsinfoId}::integer), COALESCE(#{secretYn}, 'N'), NULLIF(#{bbsPw}, ''), 0, 0, 0, COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), NULLIF(#{noticeStartDt}, ''), NULLIF(#{noticeEndDt}, ''), TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_bbs SET title = #{title}, context = #{context}, secret_yn = COALESCE(#{secretYn}, 'N'), bbs_pw = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{bbsPw}, ''), bbs_pw), notice_yn = COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), notice_start_dt = NULLIF(#{noticeStartDt}, ''), notice_end_dt = NULLIF(#{noticeEndDt}, ''), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE bbs_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_bbs SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE bbs_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_bbs SET view_cnt = COALESCE(view_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE bbs_id = #{dbKey}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT bbsinfo_id::TEXT FROM t_bbs WHERE bbs_id = #{bbsId}::integer
